**Summary: Kelso Ridge bus changes (from Monday 19 January)**

The regional transport authority is overhauling bus services for Kelso Ridge and Mill Flat, following a six-week consultation.

- **Route 410:** Every 15 minutes at weekday peak times, up from every 30.
- **New Route 412:** Links Mill Flat to Kelso Ridge station and the shopping centre, every 20 minutes, 6am–9pm, daily.
- **Route 408:** Scrapped (averages nine passengers per trip); the 412 covers its stops.
- **Concern:** Industrial estate workers say the 412 doesn't start early enough. The authority will monitor demand and may add earlier services.
- **Unchanged:** Fares.

Timetables will be letterboxed in December and appear in apps in early January. An information stall runs Saturday 6 December, 10am–2pm, at the shopping centre.
